column1: # This APK-owned allowlist selects the reviewed, single-asset execution specs
# from local_chains.json. Mutable remote chain configuration is discovery-only
# and cannot add or alter transaction authority.
# No route is approved. Every route that used to be listed here has been retired:
# - Moonbeam, Moonriver and Parallel are no longer registered on their relay chains
#   (Moonbeam and Moonriver were sunset in July 2026, Parallel stopped operating).
# - Since the Asset Hub Migration (Kusama 2025-10-07, Polkadot 2025-11-04) DOT and KSM
#   live on Asset Hub. limitedReserveTransferAssets from or to a relay chain is rejected
#   on chain (Filtered / InvalidAssetUnknownReserve); only relay <-> Asset Hub
